objective: The new lions in the game: the Lion and the Sun Lion get the faceted models of decision 0050, and the Shadow Lion joins as the Lion's legendary variant (twist speed).
acceptance_criteria: The Lion, the Sun Lion and the Shadow Lion load in the game with the new models, rigged and animated like every creature
A legendary roll on a Lion hatches a Shadow Lion; a mythic roll still hatches a Sun Lion; no other odds change
Every species has at most one variant of each tier (the spec checks it)
The lions' clips fit the new model: paws on the ground in the crouch, the tail clear of the ground in the leap and the win pose
